results.evidence: Targeted integration verification passed: 3410 exact dependency reports, including all 35 new declarations, with only standard Lean axioms. The complete registered build and fresh Q1-Q4 global coefficient-address certificates and projection regression module passed. Unchanged legacy interpreter checks were not freshly rerun. All 29 hardware Python tests passed, including coefficient/output alias rejection and adjacent-boundary acceptance. Saved PTX binding passed for 30 layouts: 720 contractions, 630 shared stores, 90 middle slices, 90 final bodies and 30 residual entries. All 30 concrete output extents are beyond their coefficient regions. Focused contraction audit passed 83 endpoints; 89 contraction-receipt and 87 residual-receipt source hashes match. Distribution and whitespace checks passed, guide links resolve, and Stratic has no issues. Exact before/after snapshots match. Source restriction preserves original store occurrences and barrier publication after renumbering; a one-byte-overlap mutation is rejected. Actual coefficient-load bounds and fetched output-tail frame properties are proved. The projected arithmetic theorem explicitly takes a retained arithmetic run, an order-preserving event embedding and omitted-store address bounds. Deriving these and the final-state relation from a full concurrent tail execution remains open, as do the previously stated full-kernel and PTX-admission boundaries.
